app_info.subtitle: Validate ontology artifacts
app_info.description: Validate selected ontology artifact schemas and evidence metadata offline, convert selected Code Ontology snapshots with explicit mapping-loss and unverified-revision reports, compare exact draft version pairings, and plan supported identity migrations without modifying inputs.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes bounded validation or compatibility results without retaining inputs or changing files.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates locally within the private application and cannot publish content or modify third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a bounded selected artifact and mapping-loss report from supplied JSON without reading source files, retaining inputs, or changing state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact remote services, follow evidence locators, or publish content to external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: The MCP operation has no file output, overwrite, deletion, revocation, or irreversible action.

test_cases.user_prompt: Validate this attached synthetic context-decision artifact.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns supported draft conformance layers; truth and authority remain not_checked.

test_cases.user_prompt: Convert this supplied Code Ontology 0.6.0 snapshot using my selected repository identity, revision annotation and exact symbol selection, and report omitted information.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a validated draft code-reference artifact preserving selected IDs and static evidence, explicit omission counts, and revision binding not_checked; no code executes or files change.

test_cases.user_prompt: Explain validation errors in this synthetic artifact with a dangling reference.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded invalid result with pointer and rule, without echoing the input.

test_cases.user_prompt: Check whether the draft producer version matches this draft reader for context-decision.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only the explicit supported pairing; untested versions remain unsupported.

test_cases.user_prompt: Plan same-version preservation, then assess a migration to an unknown version.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an identity plan for supported input and explicit unsupported status for the unknown migration; changes no file.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke this plugin; calendar actions are outside its scope.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Store my password and payment card details.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke this plugin for collecting or storing secrets or sensitive payment information.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Review my employment contract and certify its legality.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke; this tool validates ontology artifacts, not legal contracts.
